# TourScanner API guide

> Examples and notes for the TourScanner API: search tours and activities, check live availability, book them, and connect an AI agent through the MCP server. Base URL https://tourscanner.ai, API key required.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): get a key, first request, the booking flow, common mistakes
- [Booking flow](docs/booking.md): availability, options, hold, Stripe checkout, confirm, with request and response bodies
- [MCP server](docs/mcp.md): the 12 tools and client setup for Claude, Cursor, VS Code and Codex

## Code

- [Node examples](examples/node): search, availability, book
- [Python examples](examples/python): search, availability, book
- [Ruby examples](examples/ruby): search, availability, book
- [Go example](examples/go): one program, three commands
- [curl scripts](examples/curl): search, availability

## Reference

- [API docs](https://tourscanner.ai/docs)
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://tourscanner.ai/openapi.json)
- [MCP page](https://tourscanner.ai/mcp)
- [Site llms.txt](https://tourscanner.ai/llms.txt)

## Facts worth knowing

- Auth is an `X-API-Key` header. Keys are issued by email: api@tourscanner.ai.
- Prices are integers in minor units (5400 is 54.00).
- Booking flow: `POST /api/availability/slots`, `POST /api/booking/options`, `POST /api/booking/hold` (returns a Stripe `checkoutUrl`), then `POST /api/booking/confirm` with the Stripe `session_id`.
- The MCP endpoint is `https://tourscanner.ai/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, same key).
